rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a beam or ray of light or radiation.

example.english: This ray of light is shining into my eyes so I can’t keep them open.
example.traditional: 呢道光線照到我眼都睜唔開。
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 gwong1 sin3 ziu3 dou3 ngo5 ngaan5 dou1 zaang1 m4 hoi1

rows.note: Use this for a manta ray, the large flat sea animal with wing-like fins.

example.english: There’s a huge ray at the aquarium.
example.traditional: 水族館入面有條好大嘅魔鬼魚。
example.jyutping: seoi2 zuk6 gun2 jap6 min6 jau5 tiu4 hou2 daai6 ge3 mo1 gwai2 jyu2
